scenes.text: A member's fund apart from their own campaign, usually pitched as a way to help other candidates.
scenes.sub: Kennedy's is Common Sense for America PAC. 96% of its money came from individuals, mostly in gifts of $200 or less.
scenes.source: FEC committee C00634774; FEC receipts by size

scenes.title: Of the $14.0M it spent:
scenes.note: For every $1 to candidates, about $45 on direct mail.
scenes.source: FEC itemized spending, amended reports counted once

scenes.title: Four years ago it gave most of its money to candidates. Then the money poured in.
scenes.note: Since 2023: $26.5M raised, 2% of spending to candidates.
scenes.source: FEC committee totals by two-year cycle

scenes.text: Of the 193 big leadership PACs, 27 spent 75% or more on themselves. 13 Republican, 14 Democratic.

scenes.sub: Campaign money can't go to personal use. FEC commissioners have ruled that ban doesn't cover leadership PACs.
